summary: This bill permanently extends the New Markets Tax Credit, which incentivizes investments in low-income communities, and adjusts the credit amount for inflation starting in 2026.

scores.thoughts: This bill extends and expands a tax credit, which effectively reduces government revenue and can be seen as a form of indirect government spending through tax expenditures. The inflation adjustment further increases the potential cost over time.

The bill's primary purpose is to permanently extend and adjust the New Markets Tax Credit, which directly reduces the tax burden for eligible investors. It also provides alternative minimum tax relief related to this credit.

The bill permanently extends and indexes the New Markets Tax Credit while adding AMT relief, creating an open-ended tax expenditure that reduces federal revenue and widens the deficit to fund low-income community investments; this is the sole and central purpose of the legislation.
